questions.question: When God told Moses to ordain Aaron and his sons, who was to gather at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting?
When Moses ordained Aaron and his sons, what did he wash them with before dressing them?
When Moses ordained Aaron, where did he put some of the ordination ram's blood on Aaron's body?

answers.text: His right earlobe and right thumb and right big toe
His forehead and both hands and both feet
His chest and both shoulders and his back

questions.question: Moses told Aaron and his sons to stay at the Tent of Meeting day and night for seven days. Why?

answers.text: So that they will not die
So the people can watch them
So they can rest before serving
